Et paulo post: Si cui fa- « cere licuerit, ut primum om- « ne Ius civile in genera dige- « rat, quæ perpauca sunt: dem- « de eorum generu quasi quæ- « dam membra dispertiat: tum « propriam cuiusque vim defi « nitione declaret: perfectam «

page.notes: The first word of the page, "ad", continues the previous page. The printed "f" stands for long s throughout (for example "perfecuti", "Craffus", "fe-qui", "cuiufque"), so these are read as s. The guillemets (") close each line of the quotation and are kept as printed. The page number "71" has a doubtful final digit. The word "quit" and "notada" are doubtful readings. The small mark in the right margin near the middle is not a note. The catchword "ar-" is taken from the foot of the page.
